title: 第五章　经济治理术：未来如何进入治理

zh: 第五章　经济治理术：未来如何进入治理
en: 5 Economentality: How the Future Entered Government

zh: 1947 年，一位名叫阿德里亚诺·达尼诺斯的埃及企业家在开罗一份科学期刊上发表提案，建议在尼罗河上修建一座新水坝。新坝位于五十年前英国人在阿斯旺修建的较小砌石拦河堰上游——本书开头几章曾讨论过后者——这座新的堆石结构将极其巨大，其形成的水库将向南延伸五百多公里。
“达尼诺斯是一个身负使命的人，”华盛顿世界银行的一位官员在达尼诺斯后来前往推销其计划时报告说。这位官员指出，该计划不仅涉及建坝，还涉及“与之相关的土地开垦和灌溉、发电，以及建设工厂，利用电力进行采矿、制造肥料、其他制造业，可能还有钢铁生产”。
在发表计划之前，达尼诺斯曾参观美国田纳西河流域管理局，以及法国西南部利穆赞地区类似的综合水电、河流控制、灌溉和工业化项目。这些重新组织自然力量、农业系统、能源流动、劳动力能力和物质生产的庞大计划，被称为“总体开发”。
en: In 1947, an Egyptian entrepreneur named Adriano Daninos published a proposal in a scientific journal in Cairo to build a new dam across the Nile. Placed upstream of the smaller masonry barrage built fifty years earlier by the British at Aswan, discussed in the opening chapters of this book, the new rock-filled structure would be so large that the reservoir it created would stretch more than 500 kilometres to the south.

‘Daninos is a man with a mission’, reported an official at the World Bank in Washington, where he later went to pitch his plan. The official noted that the scheme concerned not just building the dam but ‘land reclamation and irrigation connected therewith, production of power, and construction of plants to use that power in mining, making fertilizers, other manufacturing, and possibly iron and steel’.

Before publishing his plan, Daninos had visited the Tennessee Valley Authority in the United States and similar integrated hydro-electric, river control, irrigation, and industrialisation projects in the Limousin in southwest France. These gargantuan schemes for reorganising forces of nature, systems of agriculture, flows of energy, powers of labour, and material production were known as ‘total development’.

zh: 尽管项目规模巨大，达尼诺斯并没有向世界银行要钱。他只寻求帮助协调美国和欧洲工程公司的参与。资金将来自伦敦或巴黎——或者来自埃及政府在战争期间于英格兰银行积累的大额英镑债权余额，或者来自英法所有的苏伊士运河公司；该公司在水坝建成后不久就应归还埃及所有。随着战后经苏伊士运河运输的石油增长，
该公司的收入和利润正在激增。
正如苏伊士运河公司的一位董事私下向世界银行官员指出的，航运公司未来支付的运河通行费可以覆盖偿还建设贷款的成本。
这座水坝是把战时债务和战后石油收入——预期中的石油繁荣将带来这些收入——加以资本化的手段。
en: Despite the scale of the venture, Daninos was not asking the World Bank for money. He merely sought help coordinating the involvement of US and European engineering firms. The capital would come from London or Paris – either from the large credits in sterling built up by the Egyptian government at the Bank of England during the war or from the Anglo-French-owned Suez Canal Company, which was due to revert to Egyptian ownership soon after the building of the dam. The
company’s income and profits were surging with the postwar growth of oil shipments through the Canal.

As a director of the Suez Canal Company pointed out in private to officials at the World Bank, the future canal tolls paid by shipping companies could cover the cost of repaying the construction loans.
The dam was a means of capitalising the wartime debts and postwar oil revenues that the prospective petroleum boom would bring.

zh: 但世界银行不愿只扮演边缘角色。它被排除在欧洲战后重建之外，急于把自己重新塑造为向全球南方国家提供经济建议和推销华尔街贷款的渠道。
因此它主动提出协调政府和私人对水坝的融资。世界银行的参与并没有使该项目变得更便宜。相反，欧洲工程公司曾估计水坝成本约为 2 亿英镑，但当世界银行完成计算后，估计数字增加了一倍多，达到 5 亿英镑。
世界银行在方案中加上了开挖灌溉运河的成本，这些运河将使埃及农民能够减少快速生长的粮食作物，扩大生长较慢的工业作物——棉花和甘蔗——的种植面积，而这些工业作物是偿还世行将在华尔街发行的债券所必需的。但世界银行还添加了别的东西：一整套关于未来的新计算。表述这种被计算的未来的新颖方式，就是把它称为“经济”（the economy）。
en: But the Bank was unwilling to play only a marginal role. Excluded from postwar reconstruction in Europe, it was keen to reinvent itself as the conduit for the supply of economic advice and the selling of Wall Street loans to countries of the South.

So it put itself forward to coordinate government and private financing of the dam. The Bank’s involvement did not make the project any cheaper. On the contrary, European engineering firms had estimated the cost of the dam at about £200 million sterling, but when the Bank finished its calculations the estimate had more than doubled, to £500 million.

The Bank had added to the scheme the cost of digging irrigation canals that would allow Egyptian farmers to replace fast-growing food crops with more hectares of the slower-growing industrial crops – cotton and sugar cane – needed to pay off the bonds the Bank would raise on Wall Street. But the Bank had added something more: a new set of calculations about the future. The novel way to represent this calculated future was to refer to it as ‘the economy’.

zh: 错置的确定性
en: Misplaced Definiteness

zh: 大约在 1948 年，谈论经济在美国政治辩论中变得普遍。政府和报纸对这个对象的提及开始以例行、重复的方式出现，使经济第一次显得像一件既成事实。人们不再总是需要解释这个词的含义，或以某种方式对它加以限定。
en: Around 1948, it became common in American political debate to talk about the economy. References to this object in government and newspapers were starting to appear in a routine, repetitive way that made the economy appear for the first time as a matter of fact. It was no longer always necessary to explain what the term meant or to qualify it in some way.

zh: “经济整体”（the economy）这一观念本身已经存在了至少十多年。但在第二次世界大战之前的时期，这个词仍常常带有上一章所探讨的较早含义的余韵，当时“经济”描述的是一种过程，而不是一个事物。
在日常用法中，这个词仍指经济化的行为，或审慎使用有限资源的行为。例如，1933 年美国《节约法》（Economy Act）不是规制经济整体的法律。它是一项实行节约、
节省开支的法案，旨在通过削减政府工作人员薪资来减少联邦赤字。在更广泛的意义上，正如我们所见，经济一词常常指治理模式本身。如同较早的“政治经济学”短语，它仍指与有效管理人的生活和物质资源有关的行政形式和技术知识。即使在 1930 年代后期，随着这个词的新含义出现，这种较早的治理含义通常仍然存在。这个词频繁出现在报纸讨论中，话题包括计划经济与市场经济、日本的战争经济，以及德国控制经济的实验。
en: The idea of ‘the economy’ itself had been around for at least a dozen years. But in the period before the Second World War the word still often carried echoes of the older sense explored in the previous chapter, when ‘economy’ described a process, not a thing.

In everyday usage, the term still referred to the act of economising, or making prudent use of limited resources. The US Economy Act of 1933, for example, was not a law to regulate the economy. It was an act of economy, or

economising, intended to cut the federal deficit by reducing the pay of government workers. In a wider sense, as we saw, the word economy had often meant modes of government itself. As in the older phrase ‘political economy’, it still referred to forms of administration and know-how concerned with the efficient management of human lives and material resources. Even in the late 1930s, as a new meaning of the term emerged, this older sense of governing was usually still present. The word occurred frequently in newspaper discussion of topics such as planned economy versus market economy, the war economy in Japan, and the German experiment in controlled economy.

zh: 在战前几年，这个词的新含义偶尔明确出现，指作为一个独特空间或对象的“
经济整体”（the economy）。1938 年 1 月，
报道了社会研究新学院两位经济学家出版的一部专著。
该研究使用罗斯福新政所得税的新数据，主张对较富裕者征税造成了“美国经济中”投资资本的稀缺。
正如
所指出的，作者们“属于这样一个经济思想学派：它把政府干预经济视为现代危机政策的必要既定条件，英国的约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯是该学派的一位著名代言人”，这或许并非巧合。同样重要的是，新政的各项税收法案通过纳税申报表，使大量公民成为数据的生产者，从而使讨论“经济”成为可能。
雷曼兄弟为这两位经济学家提供了资金，让他们聘请一个统计学家团队，从纳税申报表中转录数字，并将其转化为对经济的衡量。
en: Occasionally, in the years before the war, the new meaning of the term appeared explicitly, referring to
economy, as a distinct space or object. In January 1938, the
reported on a monograph published by two economists at the New School for Social Research.
Using data from the new Roosevelt income taxes, the study argued that taxing the better-off had created a scarcity of investment capital ‘in the American economy’.
It was perhaps no coincidence that the authors were, as the

noted, ‘members of the school of economic thought that holds governmental intervention in the economy to be a necessary datum of modern crisis policy, of which John Maynard Keynes of England is a prominent spokesman’. Equally significant was the fact that the revenue acts of the New Deal had turned a large number of citizens, through their tax returns, into producers of the data that made it possible to discuss ‘the economy’.
Lehman Brothers had provided funds for the two economists to hire a team of statisticians to transcribe figures from the tax returns and translate them into measurements of the economy.

zh: 尽管对一家关注所得税减少投资之证据的银行来说，这种计算很有用，但它使许多经济学家感到警觉。一位书评人报告说，这本书有“严重缺陷”，尤其是其“错置的确定性”，以及“在未向读者充分警示的情况下使用高度试探性的储蓄统计数据”。“鉴于这些缺陷，”评论总结道，“希望这本书不会得到广泛追捧，尽管若无这些缺陷，凭其吸引人的形式、清晰的文风和作者显而易见的才干与诚实，它本应获得这样的反响。”
评论作者阿尔伯特·盖洛德·哈特是凯恩斯思想的皈依者，但正在研究不确定性。
en: Although useful to a bank interested in the evidence that income taxes reduced investment, this kind of calculation alarmed many economists. One reviewer reported that the book had ‘grave defects’, in particular its ‘misplaced definiteness’ and its use of ‘highly tentative savings statistics without adequate warnings to the reader’. ‘In view of these defects’, the review concluded, ‘it is to be hoped that the book will not have the popular following which its attractive form and lucid style and the manifest competence and honesty of its authors would otherwise deserve.’
The review’s author, Albert Gailord Hart, was a convert to Keynes’s ideas but was working on a study of uncertainty.

zh: 这种“错置的确定性”不受学术经济学家欢迎，却找到了更有效的塑造舆论方式。次年，即 1939 年，美国预算局从

商务部转移到新设立的总统行政办公室。那本“有缺陷”书的主要作者格哈德·科尔姆被任命为预算局新设财政处首席经济学家。在那里，他把统计学家西蒙·库兹涅茨设计的国民收入账户估算新方法引入联邦预算编制。战后，科尔姆加入杜鲁门总统新设的经济顾问委员会。在委员会，他把用于联邦预算的核算方法转用于估算所谓的“国家经济预算”。在委员会旨在教育总统和公众进行经济预测和计算的年度报告中，格式化经济的工作继续进行。经济的“错置的确定性”获得了范围更广的界定。
en: Unpopular with academic economists, this kind of ‘misplaced definiteness’ found a more effective way to shape opinion. The following year, in 1939, the US Bureau of the Budget was moved from the

Commerce Department to the new Executive Office of the President. The lead author of the ‘defective’ book, Gerhard Colm, was appointed as a chief economist in the Bureau’s new Fiscal Division. There, he introduced into federal budget making the novel methods of estimating national income accounts devised by the statistician Simon Kuznets. After the war, Colm joined the staff of President Truman’s new Council of Economic Advisers. At the Council, he transferred the accounting methods used for the federal budget to the estimating of something called ‘the nation’s economic budget’. In the annual reports of the Council, intended to educate the president and the public in economic forecasting and calculation, the work of formatting the economy proceeded. The ‘misplaced definiteness’ of the economy acquired a larger definition.

zh: 在国民收入核算被引入联邦预算计算十年后，提及“经济”变得越来越平常。我们应如何理解这种指称集体生活的新方式的出现？经济是一个新对象，还是已经存在之物的旧名称？正如我们在上一章所见，两种选择都不令人满意。
en: A decade after the introduction of national income accounting into the calculations of the federal budget, it was becoming more commonplace to refer to ‘the economy’. How should we understand the emergence of this new way of referring to collective life? Was the economy a new object, or just an old name for things that already existed? As we saw in the previous chapter, neither option is satisfactory.

zh: 我们可以说明经济如何显得是一个新对象：一个由价格总水平、工资、消费者支出、货币供应、购买力和储蓄组成的事物，由于新的商业程序、银行报告、家庭纳税申报表和其他核算形式，所有这些如今都可以估算。但经济不仅仅是一组总量。这些账户可以用来把集体世界划分为一系列单位：企业、家庭和政府部门。这些核算单位之间的货币互动可以被估算，估算值随后可以被调整，使一个账户的增加等于另一个账户的减少。账户不必只估算年度增减，还可以细分为月度报告，使资金在单位之间的流动可以被描绘为一个动态过程。
这些逐单位、逐月的流动，如今不仅表现为总量，而且表现为一个相互作用体系的各个部分。
en: We can show how the economy appeared to be a new object: a thing made up of aggregate price levels, wages, consumer spending, money supply, purchasing power, and savings, all of which could now be estimated, thanks to new business procedures, banking reports, household tax returns, and other forms of accounting. But the economy was more than just a set of aggregates. These accounts could be used to divide the collective world into a series of units: firms, households, and government departments. The monetary interactions among these accounting units could be estimated and the estimates then adjusted, so that additions to one account equalled the subtractions from another. Instead of attempting to estimate only annual additions and subtractions, the accounts could be broken down into monthly reports, so that the movement of funds between units could be depicted as a dynamic process.
These movements, from unit to unit, month by month, now appeared not just as aggregates but as parts of an interacting system.

zh: 使这个体系可见和可衡量的核算程序不仅仅是再现形式。它们是向民众征收财政收入、管理国家财政、营销和消费商品以及谋生的新方式。经济不仅提供了政府政策的新对象，就像政府也曾经关注公共
卫生、城市更新或社会福利那样。经济提供了一种更普遍的效果，这种效果此后一直未受注意：一种
的方式。
en: The accounting procedures that made this system visible and measurable were more than just forms of representation. They were new ways of raising revenue from a population, managing national finance, marketing and consuming goods, and earning livings. The economy provided not just a new object of government policy, in the way that governments had also become concerned with, for example, public
health, or urban renewal, or social welfare. The economy provided a more pervasive effect, one that has since then escaped attention: a way to

zh: 经济的制造确立了一种新的时间图式，过去、现在和未来在其中被重新定位。我们可以把这一转变作为一种新的预测结构来研究：在这种结构中，未来被动员为裁断和管理当下索取权的一种方式，并在一段危机时期之后，为资本化的目的而被稳定下来。
en: The making of the economy established a new temporal scheme in which past, present, and future were relocated. We can study this shift as a new prognostic structure, one in which the future was mobilised as a mode of adjudicating and managing claims in the present, and stabilised – after a period of crisis – for the purposes of capitalisation.

zh: 正如我们在上一章结尾简要指出的，两次世界大战之间时期在资本化过程中造成了深刻危机。第一次世界大战、社会主义政府上台、1929 年股灾、随后的大萧条以及法西斯主义和总体战争的兴起，不仅对最近被称为“资本主义”的体系构成深刻挫折，更具体地说，也对资本化过程所依赖的那种稳定、可预测的未来感构成深刻挫折。这也是作为同一过程一部分而出现的帝国主义秩序的危机时代，在中东尤为严重。第一次世界大战后奥斯曼帝国崩溃，英国和法国试图通过保护国和委任统治制度控制从埃及到伊拉克的整个地区，但在很大程度上失败了。最大的失败在巴勒斯坦，1936—9 年大起义——巴勒斯坦人反对英国对巴勒斯坦的占领及其推动的犹太复国主义殖民——需要十万英军才能暴力镇压。
我们将在下文回到这场暴力在巴勒斯坦和该地区其他地方造成的后果，把它与经济制造以及发现“经济”似乎许诺的、通过战后“发展”方案实现的未来联系起来。与此同时，本章旨在把发展的诞生——中东是其首要试验场——与新兴帝国中心美国政治中平行的未来生产联系起来。
en: As we noted briefly at the end of the previous chapter, the interwar period produced a deep crisis in the processes of capitalisation. The Great War, the coming to power of socialist governments, the Crash of 1929, the Great Depression that followed, and the rise of fascism and total war marked profound setbacks not only for the system that had recently come to be known as ‘capitalism’, but more specifically for the sense of a stable, predictable future on which the capitalising process depended. This was also an era of crisis in the order of imperialism that had emerged as part of the same process, nowhere more than in the Middle East. Following the collapse of the Ottoman Empire after the First World War, Britain and France had attempted to control the entire region from Egypt to Iraq through a system of protectorates and mandates, and largely failed. The greatest failure was in Palestine, where the Great Revolt of 1936–9, the Palestinian uprising against Britain’s occupation of the country and the Zionist colonisation it promoted, required 100,000 British troops for its violent suppression.

We will return below to the aftermath of this violence, in Palestine and other parts of the region, to connect it to the making of the economy and the kinds of future, through schemes of postwar ‘development’, that the discovery of ‘the economy’ appeared to promise. At the same time, this chapter aims to connect the birth of development, for which the Middle East formed a prime testing ground, with a parallel production of the future in the politics of the emergent imperial centre, the United States.

zh: 通过未来新形式所想象的当下治理，将在一种新的时间变化度量即“增长”的衡量中运作。这种度量可以追溯到新的经济计算方法。然而，确立衡量过程不仅涉及设计计算技术。它还需要确保和稳定若干支持这种新计量学的场所。本章通过追溯对资本化工作日益关键的一个方面来说明这是如何发生的：
能源供应的流动和监管。
en: The government of the present, as it was imagined through new forms of the future, would come to operate within a new metric of temporal change, the measurement of ‘growth’. This metric can be traced in novel methods of economic calculation. However, establishing the process of measurement involved more than just devising calculative techniques. It required securing and stabilising a number of sites that would support the new metrology. This chapter illustrates how this happened by tracing one aspect of the process that was
increasingly vital to the work of capitalisation: the flow and regulation of energy supplies.

zh: 1948 年：民主的基础设施
en: 1948: An Infrastructure of Democracy

zh: 有时人们认为，现代以化石燃料为基础的新能源体制，使工业化社会中可获得的能源数量呈指数增长，是时间突然加速和未来不可预测性的重要来源。虽然能源消费、尤其是石油消费从二十世纪中叶前后迅速攀升，但这种消费矛盾地促成了一个时代，在其中未来一度成为治理人口的稳定工具的一部分。
en: It is sometimes argued that the new energy regime of the modern era, based on fossil fuels, which allowed the quantity of energy available in industrialising societies to increase exponentially, was an important source of the sudden acceleration of time and the unpredictability of futures. While the consumption of energy, in particular from oil, climbed rapidly from around the middle of the twentieth century, this consumption, paradoxically, contributed to an era in which the future became, for a while, part of a stable instrument for governing populations.

zh: 据说现代的权力通过我们有时称为治理术的理性形式、计算模式和控制策略来运作：以人口为对象、通过改善其健康、财富和福祉来治理的权力方法。米歇尔·福柯认为，这些方法的传播导致“国家的治理化”。
如果二十世纪中叶出现的新政治理性形式和计算实践把经济构成为其对象，并把未来引入治理，或许我们可以把这种治理术称为“经济治理术”（economentality）。
en: Power in the modern era is said to work through forms of reason, modes of calculation, and tactics of control that we sometimes refer to as governmentality: methods of power that take the population as their object and govern through the improvement of its health, wealth, and well-being. Michel Foucault argued that the spread of these methods leads to the ‘the governmentalization of the state’.

If new forms of political reason and calculative practice emerging in the mid-twentieth century formed the economy as their object and introduced the future into government, perhaps we can refer to this mode of governmentality as ‘economentality’.

zh: 经济治理术依托于我们在上一章称为“经济化”的那些过程：把行动、装置和领域集合起来，由经济学家和其他人定性并格式化为经济性的。
目的不是把注意力从经济转向经济化，而是把经济的制造理解为一种经济化参与其中的效果。经济学从不只是再现经济，但我们只有在经济学与其他治理模式——那些利用经济治理术之可能性的治理模式——的关系中，才能理解经济学的工作。
en: Economentality draws upon those processes that, in the previous chapter, we identified as ‘economisation’: the assembling of actions, devices, and fields that are characterised and formatted by economists and others as being economic.

The aim is not to shift attention from the economy to economisation but to understand the making of the economy as an effect in which economisation plays a part. Economics never merely represents the economic, but we can understand the work of economics only in its relation to other modes of government that draw upon the possibilities of economentality.

zh: 经济治理术，以及由此形成的经济整体，是作为围绕资本化的斗争的一部分而出现的。两次世界大战之间的危机代表着全世界整个通过企业利润资本化从未来攫取收入体系的近乎崩溃。战后，在北美、欧洲和世界许多其他地区，有组织的工人和社会主义政府努力发展企业资本化的替代方案，其基础是工业的
国家所有制、工会的加强、工人在企业利润分配中的权利，以及在埃及和全球南方许多地区对工商业外资所有权的限制。这些努力引发了一个前所未有的劳工斗争时期——参与工人人数之众、世界各地斗争场所范围之广，都前所未有。
en: Economentality, and thus the economy, emerged as part of a struggle over capitalisation. The crises of the interwar period represented the near collapse, around the world, of the entire system of capturing income from the future through the capitalising of corporate profit. After the war, in North America, Europe, and many other parts of the world, organised workers and socialist governments made efforts to develop alternatives to corporate capitalisation, based on the state

ownership of industry, the strengthening of labour unions, worker rights in the allocation of corporate profits, and – in Egypt and many parts of the South – limits on the foreign ownership of businesses. These efforts provoked a period of unprecedented labour struggle – unprecedented in the number of workers involved and the range of sites around the world where the battles occurred.

zh: 人们可以通过追踪单一年份的冲突，追溯政府如何回应这些斗争，以及美国、欧洲和中东之间如何形成新联系。1948 年 5 月 10 日，杜鲁门总统命令美国军队接管全国铁路，置于军事运营之下。与此同时，一位联邦地区法官对铁路工会领袖发出禁令。接管和禁令阻止了原定次日早晨举行的全国铁路罢工。一个月前，法院曾被类似地用来结束 40 万煤矿工人要求公司退休养老金的为期四周的罢工。
前一年通过的《塔夫脱—哈特利法》赋予法院阻止罢工的新权力，撤销了新政期间赢得的一些劳工权利。该法案是对美国历史上最大规模劳工行动浪潮的回应。1945—6 年的罢工从已被置于军队控制下的美国炼油厂开始，蔓延到铁路、电气工人、电力公司、钢铁业和汽车制造业。联邦政府曾部署武装部队接管炼油厂，随后又（两次）接管煤矿，并且至少在此前一次接管过铁路。
en: One can trace the way in which governments responded to these struggles by following in a single year of strife the making of new connections among America, Europe, and the Middle East. On 10 May 1948, President Truman ordered the US army to seize control of the country’s railways and place them under military operation. At the same time, a federal district judge issued an injunction against the leaders of the railroad unions. The seizure and injunction prevented a national railway strike planned for the following morning. A month before, the courts had been used in a similar way to end a four-week strike by 400,000 coal miners seeking company retirement pensions.

The Taft–Hartley Act of the previous year gave courts a new power to prevent strikes, undoing some of the labour rights won during the New Deal. The act was a response to the largest wave of industrial action in US history. Starting in the country’s oil refineries, which had been placed under army control, the 1945–6 strikes had spread to railways, electrical workers, power companies, the steel industry, and automobile manufacturing. The federal government had deployed the armed forces to seize control of the oil refineries, then the coal mines (twice), and, on at least one previous occasion, the railways.

zh: 新的《塔夫脱—哈特利法》权力不能用于铁路工会，后者受单独法律制度《铁路劳动法》管辖。为了绕开这个问题并阻止 1948 年 5 月的新罢工，法院声称拥有阻止铁路罢工的一般权力。它为这种扩大了的权力辩护，理由是全国铁路停运将“危害国民健康与安全”，并妨碍“至关重要且必要的政府职能”。法院主张，它有权采取行动防止国家遭受这种“不可弥补的伤害”。
通过援引对国民安全的威胁来为和平时期使用军事力量辩护，把政府在国内对有组织工人要求的打击与新的国家安全话语联系起来。1947 年 7 月的《国家安全法》开启了政府的重新军事化，设立了国防部、中央情报局和国家安全委员会。杜鲁门总统在总统
专机——一架绰号
的道格拉斯 C-54“空中霸王”——上签署该法案成为法律，这似乎再合适不过。和平时期的军国主义将成为美国的神圣不可侵犯之物，越来越不受批评。有人声称，如今需要和平时期的军国主义来保护欧洲，并越来越多地用来保卫中东油田。波斯湾能源资源对美国“安全”至关重要这一新观念，与国内的劳工斗争联系在一起。
en: The new Taft–Hartley powers could not be used against rail unions, which were governed under a separate legal regime, the Railway Labor Act. To get around this problem and prevent the new strike in May 1948, the court claimed a general power to prevent rail strikes. It justified this expanded power on the grounds that a nationwide rail stoppage would ‘imperil national health and safety’ and obstruct ‘vital and necessary Government functions’. The court was empowered to act, it argued, to prevent this ‘irreparable injury’ to the country.

Justifying the peacetime use of military power by invoking the threat to national safety linked the government’s domestic fight against the claims of organised workers to a new idiom of national security. The National Security Act of July 1947 inaugurated the remilitarisation of government, setting up the Department of Defense, the Central Intelligence Agency, and the National Security Council. It seems only appropriate that President Truman signed the act into law aboard his presidential
aircraft, a Douglas C-54 Skymaster nicknamed

. Peacetime militarism was to be America’s sacred cow, acquiring an increasing immunity from criticism. Peacetime militarism was now required, it was claimed, for the protection of Europe and, increasingly, to defend the oil fields of the Middle East. The novel idea that the energy resources of the Persian Gulf were important to the ‘security’ of the United States was connected to the labour struggles at home.
body.review: 校注：底本把1947年设立的机构直接称为国防部。美国国会访客中心对档案的说明区分1947年的National Military Establishment与1949年修法后采用的Department of Defense名称。正文保留原作概述。 https://www.visitthecapitol.gov/artifact/new-organization-national-defense-chart-accompanying-statement-secretary-war-robert-p

zh: 为回应战后煤炭和铁路罢工，电力公司和铁路公司开始加强自身以对抗劳工要求，办法是开发替代能源，从使用煤炭转向燃烧石油，从而削弱大众民主扩大了的诉求。部分因此，1948 年美国历史上首次成为石油净进口国，尽管当时它正生产世界供应的 60%。
en: In response to the postwar coal and railway strikes, electric power companies and railroad firms began to strengthen themselves against labour demands, thus weakening the expanded claims of popular democracy by developing an alternative source of energy, switching from using coal to burning oil. Partly as a result, in 1948 the United States became, for the first time in its history, a net importer of oil, even though it was then producing 60 per cent of the world’s supply.

zh: 美国希望在欧洲策划类似的劳工运动削弱。就在全国铁路罢工被击败的同一天，大西洋彼岸的波尔多，第一艘运载马歇尔计划援助的船只开始卸货，船上载有 8,800 吨美国小麦。

美国援助不仅旨在重建欧洲，还旨在加强其商业阶级，以对抗比美国更强大的矿工、铁路工人和其他有工会组织的力量。在英国、法国和欧洲大陆其他地区，由煤矿工人及其在其他工会的盟友领导的罢工，要求扩大第一次世界大战之前及此后赢得的社会和民主权利，包括在工业管理或所有权中发挥作用的集体权利。对于管理欧洲复兴计划（马歇尔计划的正式名称）的美国商人来说，美国援助将被用来削弱这种左翼对企业所有权和工业控制的威胁。部分出于这个原因，马歇尔计划资金的最大支出不是用于美国谷物，而是用于中东石油。美国补贴了欧洲主要化石燃料来源从煤炭向石油的转换。这种转换部分旨在削弱欧洲煤矿工人，从而破坏左翼的力量。
en: The United States hoped to engineer a similar weakening of the labour movements in Europe. On the same day that the national railroad strike was defeated, across the Atlantic in Bordeaux, the first ship carrying Marshall Plan aid began unloading its cargo, 8,800 tons of American wheat.

US aid was intended not just to rebuild Europe but to strengthen its business class against miners, railway workers, and other unionised forces even more powerful than those in the United States. In Britain, France, and other parts of the continent, strikes led by coal miners and their allies in other unions were demanding an extension of the social and democratic rights won before and since the First World War, including a collective right to a role in the management or ownership of industry. For the American businessmen who ran the European Recovery Plan, as the Marshall Plan was formally known, US aid was to be used to weaken this left-wing threat to the corporate ownership and control of industry. Partly for this reason, the largest expenditure of Marshall Plan funds was not on US grain but on oil from the Middle East. The United States subsidised the conversion of Europe’s principal source of fossil fuel from coal to oil. The conversion was intended, in part, to weaken the coal miners of Europe and thus undermine the power of the left.

zh: 作为一种能源，石油具有若干优势，使其较不容易受到劳工要求的影响，因而也较不容易受到对资本化的威胁。仅仅通过补充煤炭供应，它就削弱了煤矿工人在铁路工人和码头工人协同下关闭一国碳能源系统的能力。总罢工的武器——随着 1880 年代煤炭、铁路和电力网络的
建设而组装起来，此后在工业化世界迅速用来赢得争取更民主、更平等的集体生活形式的斗争——如今被拆除了。石油可以用泵和管道开采到地表并分配，因此其生产和分配所需工人更少，也更难以用罢工行动中断。与煤炭不同，石油足够轻，容易跨洋运输。因此，以前使用煤炭实现工业化的地区——把工业建在能源来源附近，因而容易受到当地能源供应中断的影响——如今可以开始把能源供应外包出去。
en: Oil had a number of advantages as a source of energy that made it less vulnerable to the demands of labour and thus to threats against capitalisation. Simply by supplementing coal supplies, it weakened the ability of coal miners, in alliance with railwaymen and dockworkers, to shut down a country’s carbon energy system. The weapon of the general strike – assembled with the building of coal, rail, and electric networks

in the 1880s, and used rapidly thereafter across the industrialising world to win battles for more democratic and egalitarian forms of collective life – was now dismantled. Oil could be raised to the surface and distributed using pumps and pipelines, so its production and distribution required fewer workers and was more difficult to interrupt with strike actions. Unlike coal, it was light enough to be moved easily across oceans. So, regions that had previously industrialised using coal, building industries close to the source of energy and thus vulnerable to the interruption of local energy supplies, could now begin to outsource the supply of energy.

zh: 战后中东石油的开发可以视为欧洲工业生产的外包。制造业外包再过二三十年才变得重要，那是在集装箱航运发展之后；集装箱航运使发达工业化国家能够开始从东亚进口大量制成品。另一方面，能源可以说在远洋油轮和长途管道发展之后就已被“集装箱化”了。
en: The postwar development of Middle Eastern oil can be viewed as an outsourcing of European industrial production. The outsourcing of manufacturing did not become significant for another two or three decades, following the development of containerised shipping, which allowed the advanced industrialised countries to begin importing large quantities of manufactured goods from East Asia. Energy, on the other hand, had already been containerised, as it were, ever since the development of the ocean-going oil tanker and the long-distance pipeline.

zh: 1947 年，沙特阿拉伯的工人开始修建跨阿拉伯输油管道，这是当时世界上最大的管道。购买了沙特阿拉伯石油生产权的美国公司计划把石油从该国东海岸经陆路输送到巴勒斯坦海法港的一个储油库；海法是一条由英国修建、从伊拉克出发的既有输油管道的终点。这些管道及相关油轮航线提供了把西方能源生产转移到海外的设施。在这个过程中，它们也在建设一种新的民主基础设施，争取更有保障的集体生活的斗争将在这一更广阔的网络中展开。
en: In 1947, workers in Saudi Arabia had begun constructing the Trans-Arabian Pipeline, the world’s largest pipeline at that time. The US companies that had purchased rights to produce oil in Saudi Arabia planned to pump the oil overland from the eastern shore of the country to an oil depot at the port of Haifa in Palestine, the terminus of an existing British-built pipeline from Iraq. Such pipelines and the associated tanker routes provided the infrastructure for moving the West’s energy production offshore. In the process, they were also building a new infrastructure of democracy, in which struggles for a less precarious collective life would be waged over a more extended network.

zh: 在杜鲁门宣布对美国铁路实施军事控制的 1948 年 5 月同一周，另一场军事对抗在巴格达以西四十英里、幼发拉底河畔的伊拉克城镇费卢杰以失败告终。
en: In the same week of May 1948 that Truman was declaring military control of American railways, another military confrontation was culminating in a defeat at the Iraqi town of Falluja, on the Euphrates River, forty miles west of Baghdad.

zh: 费卢杰的失败是一场酝酿了两年的斗争的最后一步。1946 年 6 月，基尔库克英美合资伊拉克石油公司油田——石油从那里经管道输往海法——的一次罢工被镇压；石油工人当时要求组建工会的权利、疾病和伤残保险以及养老金。
一队骑警冲进数百名工人聚集在城外加乌帕吉花园的集会，杀死十名工人，打伤另外二十七人。1948 年初，一系列学生
和工人罢工引发了反对英国支持的君主制和英国经营的石油公司的全国抗议。这一次，石油工人没有把行动集中在油田，而是在“基尔库克—海法和基尔库克—的黎波里两条管道的分岔点，即哈迪萨附近的 K3 泵站”，并使其停运。
停运持续了两周，直到公司用机枪和装甲车包围现场并切断食物供应。罢工者无法冒着重演加乌帕吉屠杀的风险，决定向一百五十多英里外的巴格达进军。他们于 5 月 12 日出发，即美国铁路罢工失败后的第二天。经过三天行军，沿途支持不断增加，他们进入费卢杰，“落入……警察的陷阱”。
石油工人被送回 K3，罢工领袖被送进监狱。
en: The Falluja defeat was the last step in a struggle that had been building for two years. In June 1946, a strike at the Anglo-American-owned Iraq Petroleum Company fields in Kirkuk, the site from which oil was piped to Haifa – by oil workers demanding the right to a union, sickness and disability insurance, and a pension – had been crushed.

A force of mounted policemen charged the meeting of several hundred workers gathered in the Gawupaghi Gardens outside the town, killing ten workers and injuring another twenty-seven. In early 1948 a series of student

and worker strikes led to nationwide protests against the British-backed monarchy and the British-run oil company. This time, the oil workers focused their action not on the oil fields but at ‘the point of bifurcation of the Kirkūk–Haifa and the Kirkūk–Tripoli pipelines, the K3 pumping station near Hadīthah’, which they shut down.

The stoppage lasted two weeks, until the Company surrounded the site with machine guns and armoured cars and cut off supplies of food. Unable to risk a repeat of the massacre at Gawupaghi, the strikers decided to march on Baghdad, more than 150 miles away. They set out on 12 May, the day after the defeat of the railroad strike in the United States. After three days of marching, with increasing support along the way, they entered Falluja and ‘fell into . . . a police trap’.
The oil workers were sent back to K3, and the strike leaders to prison.

zh: 伊拉克石油工人的失败，在同一时期伊朗以及后来巴林和沙特阿拉伯的石油罢工被打破时重演。沙特石油工人要求美国石油公司阿美公司提高工资和改善生活条件，要求组建工会的权利，要求政府制定政治宪法，并要求取消美国石油公司的治外法权。在埃及，正如我们即将看到的，一波罢工在与伊拉克石油工人抗议同一周被终结。
en: Defeat for Iraqi oil workers was repeated in the breaking of oil strikes in Iran in the same period, and later in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia. The Saudi oil workers demanded better pay and living conditions from the American oil company Aramco, the right to form a union, a political constitution from the government, and the removal of extra-territorial privileges for the American oil company. In Egypt, as we will shortly see, a wave of strikes was brought to an end in the same week as the oil workers’ protests in Iraq.

zh: 1948 年以两次将塑造战后中东的挫折为标志。一是伊拉克石油工人在费卢杰的失败，这对以石油开采为基础的工人运动是一次逆转——这些运动分散在地区各处、远离欧洲，因而无法像欧洲煤矿工人那样享有相互联动、能够中断生产和供应的民主集体行动的可能性，因为欧洲煤矿工人与能源使用场所紧密相连。二是殖民权力的重组，其中心是同年发生在巴勒斯坦的灾难。战前，殖民列强通常通过声称有权“保护”某些人口——特别是欧洲定居者殖民地和宗教少数群体社区——来为他们在该地区的存在辩护。随着美国开始取代英国和法国成为该地区主要帝国强权，它开始围绕一种新学说即“安全”学说来重塑其权力辩护——首先是石油安全，后来是刚刚采用“以色列”名称的新定居者国家的安全。
第一次挫折，如前所述，发生在伊拉克费卢杰；第二次挫折发生在巴勒斯坦，恰好在一个同名之地以失败告终。
en: The year 1948 was marked by two setbacks that would shape the postwar Middle East. One was the defeat of the Iraqi oil workers at Falluja, a reversal for worker movements based in oil extraction – movements whose dispersion across the region and distance from Europe deprived them of the possibilities for interconnected, disruptive, democratic collective action that coal workers in Europe, tied closely to the sites of energy use, had enjoyed. The second was a reconfiguring of colonial power, centred in the calamity that same year in Palestine. Before the war, colonial powers had typically justified their presence in the region by claiming the right to ‘protect’ certain populations, specifically colonies of European settlers and communities of religious minorities. As the United States began to replace Britain and France as the principal imperial power in the region, it started to recast the justification for its power around a new doctrine, the doctrine of ‘security’ – first of oil and later of the new settler state that had just adopted the name ‘Israel’.
The first of these setbacks, as already mentioned, took place in Falluja, Iraq; the second, in Palestine, happened to culminate in defeat at a place that shared the same name.

zh: 经济的诞生
en: The Birth of the Economy

zh: 1948 年，华盛顿新成立的经济顾问委员会（CEA）发表了第二份“总统向国会提交的年度报告”。上一年的首份报告包含了美国经济的第一批官方统计再现。但那份报告没有把其对象命名为经济，也很少使用这个新词，更愿意讨论“国家经济预算”。然而仅仅一年后，在 1948 年报告中，人们可以看到经济观念的熟悉化，这个词开始越来越频繁地被使用。五年后，即 1953 年，报告删去了“国家经济预算”一词。年度账户的导言解释说，它们阐明了“经济内部的变革和调整过程”。与此同时，报告警告说，年度账户无法捕捉这个对象的动态运动。这些账户更像是“间隔拍摄的快照，而不是展示变化过程的电影”。
en: In 1948, the new Council of Economic Advisors (CEA) in Washington published its second ‘Annual Report of the President to Congress’. Its inaugural report the previous year had contained the first official statistical representations of the American economy. But that report did not name its object as the economy and contained few uses of the new term, preferring to discuss ‘the nation’s economic budget’. But, only a year later, in the 1948 report, one can see the familiarisation of the idea of the economy, which begins to be used with increasing frequency. Five years later, in 1953, the report dropped the term ‘nation’s economic budget’. The introduction to the annual accounts explains that they illuminate ‘the process of change and adjustment within the economy’. The report warned, at the same time, that annual accounts could not capture the dynamic movement of this object. The accounts were more like ‘snapshots taken at intervals than like a moving picture which shows the process of change’.

zh: 历史学家强调经济顾问委员会设立过程中的两点。第一，它的创建标志着学术专业知识在行政部门中前所未有地发挥影响。对经济学家来说，经济顾问委员会是他们为国家服务的“制度顶峰”。
第二，这种专业知识代表着“经济增长术”的出现和胜利。
为了理解通过治理未来来确保资本化的新方式的出现，我们可以对这段叙述提出两点修改。
en: Historians have emphasised two points about the setting up of the CEA. First, its creation marks an unprecedented influence of academic expertise within executive office. For economists, the CEA was ‘the institutional zenith’ for their service to the state.
Second, this expertise represents the emergence and triumph of ‘economic growthmanship’.
We can propose two modifications to this story for understanding the emergence of new modes of securing capitalisation through governing the future.

zh: 第一，经济顾问委员会的设立不是为了让经济学家进入政府，而是为了把他们排除在外。
更准确地说，它旨在实现权力分立，创造一种类似于联邦储备委员会、最高法院或新参谋长联席会议准独立地位的安排，或者从另一种意义上说，类似于“国家安全”新领域——中东是这一领域的重要参照点。经济顾问委员会将在政治辩论的日常争夺之外生产公开的经济知识，促成经济作为独立于国家的对象的平行效果，使它作为一种独立于治理过程的可见机制运作。
en: First, the CEA was set up not to allow economists into government but to keep them out.

More precisely, it was intended to effect a separation of the powers, creating an arrangement analogous to the quasiindependence of the Federal Reserve, the Supreme Court, or the new Joint Chiefs of Staff, or analogous in another sense to the new realm of ‘national security’ for which the Middle East served as an important reference point. The CEA would produce public economic knowledge outside the day-to-day contestations of political debate, contributing to the parallel effect of the economy as an object separate from the state that operated as a visible mechanism independent of the process of government.

zh: 国会设立经济顾问委员会，是对战后《充分就业法案》提案的反应，该提案本会把充分就业确立为一项集体权利。就业权的反对者把设立委员会的计划插入《就业法案》，以削弱

战时经济学家在政府中的影响，以及他们在战争期间为最大化就业和控制价格而发展出的机制。反对者希望通过让学术经济学家在华盛顿发声，来削弱这些政府经济学家：经济顾问委员会将表达决策过程之外专家的观点。与隐藏在政府部门内部的经济学家不同，这些“借调学者”将被迫通过向国会新设联合委员会提交年度报告，公开他们的建议及其依据的证据。通过使经济计算公开化，右翼势力希望揭露其不确定性并限制其影响。经济顾问委员会将成为这种公开化的装置，用于“经济教育”（从教育总统开始）。它的定期报告将有助于使经济这一对象得以形成。
en: Congress created the CEA in reaction against postwar proposals for a Full Employment Act, which would have established full employment as a collective right. Opponents of the right to employment inserted the plan for the Council into the Employment Bill, to weaken the influence

of wartime economists in government and the mechanisms they had developed during the war for maximising employment and controlling prices. The opponents hoped to undermine these government economists by giving a voice in Washington to academic economists: the CEA would express the views of specialists from outside the decision-making process. In contrast to economists hidden from view inside government departments, these academics-on-loan would be forced to make public their advice and the evidence on which it was based, through an annual report to a new joint committee of Congress. By making economic calculation public, right-wing forces hoped to be able to expose its uncertainties and limit its influence. The CEA was to be a device for this making of things public, for an ‘economic education’ (starting with the education of the president). Its regular reports would help bring the economy into effect.

zh: 第二，经济专业知识往往关注增长问题：人口增加、贸易扩大、自然资源过剩或短缺，或货币供应膨胀。
在这个历史节点上，新的不是增长术，而是将要增长的对象：不是人口、贸易、资源或财富，而是某种更少物质性、因而更有效的东西：经济。经济的增长不是资源治理或国家财政管理的问题。它是一种把未来带入治理的方式——通过其未来来治理人口。
en: Second, economic expertise had often been concerned with problems of growth: the increase in population, the expansion of trade, a surfeit or shortage of natural resources, or inflation in the supply of money.

What was new in this historical juncture was not growth-manship but the object that would grow: not population, trade, resources, or wealth, but something less material and therefore more effective: the economy. The growth of the economy was not a question of the government of resources or the management of national finance. It was a means of bringing the future into government – of governing populations through their futures.

zh: 经济这一效果有什么用处？部分答案是，它允许一种既代表对立社会力量、又指出使这些对立面达到平衡之手段的治理模式。这是经济顾问委员会报告的主要方法和目的：代表并平衡“商业”和“劳工”的诉求。
面对经济不断变化的指标，商人将被迫考虑过度涨价的影响，而工人则被迫节制工资要求。第三方即银行家将看到把信用创造引向消费或投资这两种选择各自的效果。
en: What was the effect of the economy good for? Part of the answer is that it allowed a mode of government that both represented opposing social forces and indicated the means of bringing these opposites into balance. This was the chief method and purpose of the CEA reports: to represent and balance the claims of ‘business’ and ‘labor’.

Exposed to the changing metrics of the economy, businessmen would be pressured to consider the impact of excessive price increases, while workers would be forced to moderate wage demands. A third party, the bankers, would see the effect of directing credit creation towards consumption versus investment.

zh: 经济是一种通过部署未来——以经济单位之间资金不断变化的流动来计算——来实现这种平衡的装置。相互竞争的政治力量如今将看到不同要求和选择如何影响未来的平衡。经济将把人们的政治生活嵌入未来，引导他们按照其再现来计算。它将把人们定位在
与以一种特定方式形成的未来的关系中，即作为不同力量之间的平衡或权衡；这些力量如今被作为等值物铭刻进国民账户结构，一边是工资劳动者/消费者，另一边是商业和银行业。
en: The economy was a device for achieving this balance by deploying the future, calculated in terms of the changing movements of funds among economic units. Rival political forces would now see how different demands and choices affected the future balance. The economy would embed people’s political lives in the future, by leading them to calculate according to its representation. It would locate them in

relation to a future formed in a particular way, as a balance, or trade-off, between forces now inscribed as equivalents in the structure of national accounts, with wage earners/consumers on one side, and business and banking on the other.

zh: 在此之前，经济学家通常对预测工作持怀疑态度。预测是一种不可预测、因而危险的艺术，据说其过度和失败在苏联式计划的事例中显而易见。约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯在论述“困扰现代世界经济生活的信心危机”时指出，“我们据以估算十年后一条铁路、一座铜矿、一家纺织厂、一种专利药品的商誉、一艘大西洋客轮、伦敦金融城一座建筑之收益的知识基础，微不足道，有时甚至等于零”。他不相信经济计算能够克服“包裹着我们未来的时间和无知的黑暗力量”。
这种对不可知时间力量的恐惧，如今可以让位于一种被计算的未来；这种未来越来越自信地被投射到当下的政治上。
en: Until this point, economists had typically been suspicious of the work of forecasting. It was an unpredictable and therefore dangerous art, whose excesses and failures were said to be visible in the example of Soviet-style planning. Writing about ‘the crises of confidence which afflict the economic life of the modern world’, John Maynard Keynes had pointed out that ‘our basis of knowledge for estimating the yield ten years hence of a railway, a copper mine, a textile factory, the goodwill of a patent medicine, an Atlantic liner, a building in the City of London amounts to little and sometimes to nothing’. He did not believe that economic calculation could overcome ‘the dark forces of time and ignorance which envelop our future’.
This fear of unknowable temporal forces could now give way to a calculated future, projected with increasing confidence onto the politics of the present.

zh: 通过未来来治理，不仅是一个计算后来被称为国民生产总值（GNP）（后来是国内生产总值，GDP）的新资金流通的问题，或把经济当作政治对象来讨论的问题。我们可以追溯另外两项更具体的创新，它们说明生产和支配未来所需的是何种工作。
en: To govern through the future was not just a question of calculating the new circulations of funds that were to be known as the gross national product (GNP) (and later the gross domestic product, or GDP) or discussing the economy as a political object. We can trace two more specific innovations which illustrate the kind of work required to produce and command the future.

zh: 第一个例子是价格平减指数，即调整数字以计入通货膨胀、从而可以在较长年份跨度内进行比较的方法。GNP 是一个年度数字。像公司的账簿一样，它需要一个任意的起点和终点，创造出一个时间单位，其中一切必须平衡，从而产生一个总量——一个由经济实体之间无穷无尽的支付流通制造出来的固定数量。然后可以把一个时间单位内产生的总量与下一个时间单位的总量相比较，就像公司比较其季度或年度利润一样。但与报告公司利润的人不同，计算 GDP 的人希望使总量不仅可以与前一年或后一年比较，而且可以在数年甚至数十年间比较。这种延长的时间序列需要一种调整数字的方法，以计入货币购买力下降或价格通胀现象。
en: The first example is the price deflator, or the method of adjusting figures to account for inflation so that comparisons could be made over a wide span of years. The GNP was an annual figure. Like a company’s books, it required an arbitrary starting and ending point, creating a unit of time within which everything had to balance, generating a total – a fixed quantity manufactured out of the endless circulation of payments between economic entities. The total produced from within one unit of time could then be compared to the next, just as a firm compares its quarterly or annual profits. But, unlike those reporting company profits, those calculating GDP wished to make it possible to compare the total from one year not just to the preceding or following year but across several years or even decades. This extended temporal sequence required a method of adjusting the numbers to allow for the declining purchasing power of money or the phenomenon of price inflation.

zh: 通货膨胀是经济学家从十九世纪物理学借用的词语之一。
它以前指把额外信用货币供应泵入货币
体系的机械行为。如今它成为一个术语，可以指新的国家层面总量；对这些总量的计量，正在形成经济这一对象。政府预算办公室的工作人员最初拒绝计算价格通胀率的要求，认为定期收集大量商品代表性价格数据，并处理这些数字来计算总体年度通胀率，是一项过于复杂和昂贵的操作。然而最终，平减指数在建构经济方面的有用性克服了这些反对意见。
en: Inflation was one of those words borrowed by economists from nineteenth-century physics.
It was previously used to refer to the mechanical act of pumping additional supplies of credit money into the currency

system. It was now a term that could refer to the new national-level aggregates whose measurement was taking shape as the economy. The staff of the government budget office initially refused the request to calculate the rate of inflation in prices, arguing that gathering representative data on the prices of numerous commodities at regular intervals and manipulating the figures to calculate an aggregate annual inflation rate was far too complex and costly an operation. Eventually, however, the usefulness of the deflator in constructing the economy overcame these objections.

zh: 平减指数使衡量 GDP 的变化不仅可以从一年到另一年进行，而且可以跨越一系列年份或数十年。这种延长的衡量使一个动态过程——经济的增长——变得可见。通过通货膨胀调整，如今可以估算美国自 1875 年以来每一年的国民生产总值总量。估算表明，美国经济一直在以每年 3.75% 的速度增长，其间有起有落。
en: The deflator made it possible to measure the change in GDP not just from one year to the next but over a sequence of years or decades. This extended measurement made visible a dynamic process – the growth of the economy. With adjustments for inflation, it was now possible to estimate totals for the gross national product of the United States for every year back to 1875. The estimates suggested that the American economy had been growing, with ups and downs, at a rate of 3.75 per cent per year.

zh: 第二项创新在于经济学家描绘增长的方式。经济顾问委员会在其年度报告中开始用图表描绘国家“经济预算”、后来是其经济的变化。纵轴表示 GDP 水平，横轴标记年份的连续。增长现象被描绘为 GDP 的增加，如今可以在图表表面上形成一条从左向右上升的线。这条线始于过去，穿过现在，并被投射到未来。这种可视化意在教育公众，鼓励工人、雇主和金融家依据这个被投射的未来行动。它可以表明，不合理的政治要求——尤其是工人要求基于收入份额增加、而非基于自身生产率提高的更高工资——有可能使这条线偏离轨道。同样，金融业过度创造信用将危及未来的稳定。
en: A second innovation came in the way economists pictured growth. In its annual reports, the CEA began portraying changes in the nation’s ‘economic budget’, and later its economy, with a chart. The vertical axis indicated the level of GDP, while the horizontal axis marked the succession of years. The phenomenon of growth, portrayed as the increase in GDP, could now form a line ascending from left to right across the surface of the chart. The line started in the past, moved through the present, and was projected forwards into the future. The visualisation was intended to educate the public, encouraging workers, employers, and financiers to act in relation to this projected future. Unreasonable political demands, it could be shown, especially the demand of workers for higher wages based on an increased share of revenues, rather than on increases in their own productivity, would threaten to throw the line off its path. Similarly, excessive creation of credit by the financial industry would risk the stability of the future.

zh: 然而，在产量以每年接近 4% 的速度增长的情况下，这条将要支配人们生活的线并不是直线。画在图表上，它形成一条指数曲线。它起初是一个平缓上升的斜坡，但迅速升高，不久就会达到几乎垂直的角度，数值趋近无穷大。
en: However, with production growing at close to 4 per cent a year, this line that was to rule people’s lives was not straight. Drawn on a chart, it formed an exponential curve. It started as a gently rising slope but gathered height rapidly and before long would reach an angle that was almost vertical, with values approaching infinity.

zh: 指数曲线的问题有两方面。第一，当这条线接近垂直时，不同政治力量诉求的微小调整所带来的有益效果无法轻易在图表上
显现。第二，如果未来是一条加速曲线——一条指数增长线——它如何能成为规训和控制的工具？它看起来已经失控。
en: The problem of the exponential curve was twofold. First, with the line moving close to vertical, the beneficial effect of minor adjustments in the demands of different political forces could not easily be made
visible on the graph. Second, if the future was an accelerating curve – a line of exponential growth – how could it be made an instrument of discipline and control? It appeared out of control.

zh: 到目前为止，这不仅是绘制图表的问题，也是未来本身的问题。现代的增长经验以前从未提供稳定点或控制焦点。几何变化率总是显得不可持续。托马斯·马尔萨斯 1798 年首次出版的
是这一问题最著名的表述。但许多其他十九世纪政治经济学家也进行了类似计算，并对未来产生了同样的恐慌。我们在
遇到的威廉·杰文斯是 1870 年代边际效用理论的建构者之一；他在完成一份 1865 年出版的英国煤炭储量报告后，放弃了增长问题。该研究预测，英国煤炭开采和消费的指数增长将在大约五十年内达到煤炭产量峰值，然后加速下降。这一预测被证明是准确的，峰值出现在 1913 年。到二十世纪初，经济学家普遍关注几何增长的后果，包括自然资源枯竭。
en: Until now, this had been the problem not just with the drawing of graphs but with the future itself. The modern experience of growth had not previously offered a point of stability or a focus of control. Geometric rates of change always appeared unsustainable. Thomas Malthus’s

children: Essay on the Principle of Population

en: , first published in 1798, was the best-known expression of this problem. But many other nineteenth-century political economists carried out similar calculations with the same resulting alarm about the future. William Jevons, whom we met in

as one of the architects of marginal utility theory in the 1870s, had abandoned the question of growth after completing a report on Britain’s coal reserves, published in 1865. The study predicted that the exponential growth in Britain’s mining and consumption of coal would lead to a peak in coal production within about fifty years, and then an accelerating decline. The prediction proved accurate, with the peak arriving in 1913. By the early twentieth century, there was a widespread preoccupation among economists with the consequences of geometric growth, including the exhaustion of natural resources.

zh: 这种关切不只出现在政治经济学家中间。莱因哈特·科泽勒克认为，在现代，几何变化率界定了现代性的体验本身。他提出，现代性是通过“一个超越了此前可预测之物的未来”被体验到的，因为变化速度不断加快。
换言之，未来在当下被体验为这种活生生的加速感。这种体验与过去造成断裂，过去如今必须被重新配置为一种不可企及的“传统”，因为较早的历史“未必能用来否定未来可能呈现的他异性”。
新的期待视野导致了过去与未来相对位置的重新定位。
en: This concern was found not just among political economists. Reinhart Koselleck argues that in the modern era geometric rates of change defined the very experience of modernity. Modernity was encountered, he suggests, in terms of ‘a future that transcended the hitherto predictable’ because of the phenomenon of the ever-increasing speed of change.

The future, in other words, was experienced in the present as this lived sensation of acceleration. The experience created a rupture with the past, which now had to be refigured as an inaccessible ‘tradition’ because earlier history ‘might not count against the possible otherness of the future’.
The new horizons of expectation caused a repositioning, as it were, of the relative locations of past and future.

zh: 在二十世纪初的几十年里，作家们继续把现代性体验与加速变化、因而不可预测的未来联系起来。这种体验常常与人类如今可以利用的“自然能量”有关。“技术时代运作的一个方面，以其对自然能量前所未有的支配……需要明确关注，”约翰·杜威在
（1927）中写道。“较早的公众作为地方共同体，彼此之间在很大程度上同质，而且正如俗话所说，也是静止的。”杜威认为，“对运动和速度的狂热
是社会生活动荡不安的症状，它反过来加剧了它所由产生的那些原因。钢铁取代木材和砖石用于建筑；钢筋混凝土改造钢铁，某种发明可能带来进一步的革命。”
en: In the early decades of the twentieth century, writers continued to associate the experience of modernity with accelerating change and thus unpredictable futures. Very often the experience was related to the ‘natural energies’ that humans could now exploit. ‘One phase of the workings of a technological age, with its unprecedented command of natural energies, . . . needs explicit attention’, John Dewey wrote in
(1927). ‘The older publics, in being local communities, largely homogeneous with one another, were also, as the phrase goes, static.’ Dewey argued that ‘the mania for motion and speed

is a symptom of the restless instability of social life, and it operates to intensify the causes from which it springs. Steel replaces wood and masonry for buildings; ferroconcrete modifies steel, and some invention may work a further revolution.’

zh: 像阿德里亚诺·达尼诺斯——阿斯旺大坝计划推动者——这样的人后来提出的战后发展愿景，当时尚未成形。相反，在两次世界大战之间，巨大基础设施项目可以例示变化的速度，正是这种速度使可靠的未来计算无法进行。美国国会花了十多年时间辩论如何处理在阿拉巴马州马斯尔肖尔斯田纳西河上修建巨型水坝的停滞项目，之后才设计出田纳西河流域管理局方案；该方案启发了达尼诺斯等人，成为战后综合发展愿景的典范。十多年来，水坝问题在美国国会占用的时间比任何其他问题都多。
对杜威来说，马斯尔肖尔斯的失败——连同其生产弹药和化肥的相关硝酸盐工厂——所体现的不是把未来作为经济和物质增长纲领来掌握，而是不断增多的能源来源如何使新项目几乎立即过时。“新方法，”他写道，“已经使所谓大量积累水力的需要变得过时。”
en: The later, postwar visions of development presented by men like Adriano Daninos, the promoter of the scheme to build the Aswan Dam, had not yet taken shape. On the contrary, in the interwar period mammoth infrastructure projects could exemplify the speed of change that made reliable calculations of the future impossible to carry out. The US Congress spent more than a dozen years debating what to do with the stalled project to build a giant dam on the Tennessee River at Muscle Shoals, Alabama, before devising the scheme for the Tennessee Valley Authority that was to inspire Daninos and others as a model for postwar visions of integrated development. For more than a decade, the problem of the dam occupied more time in the US Congress than any other issue.

For Dewey, the failure at Muscle Shoals, with its associated nitrate plants built to produce munitions and fertiliser, epitomised not a mastery of the future as a programme of economic and material growth but the way in which proliferating sources of energy made new projects almost immediately redundant. ‘New methods’, he wrote, ‘have already made antiquated the supposed need of great accumulation of water power.’

zh: 对其他作家来说，加速的动力被认定为货币。二十世纪早期，格奥尔格·齐美尔在论述他所谓“货币经济”的心理体验时，探讨了“货币供应增加对经济—心理过程发展的加速效应”。
难怪人们怀疑金融预测不可靠且危险。齐美尔所回应的信用创造新力量，制造了未来的不稳定性。
en: For other writers, the motor of acceleration was identified as money. Writing earlier in the century about the mental experience of what he called ‘money economy’, Georg Simmel explored ‘the accelerating effects of an increase in the supply of money on the development of the economic–psychic process’.
No wonder there was a suspicion of financial forecasting as unreliable and dangerous. The new powers of credit creation, to which Simmel was responding, generated the instability of the future.

zh: 苏联中央计划的例子或许提供了一种控制未来的替代方式，但它看起来并不更好。作为 1929 年“国民经济发展五年计划”的核心项目，苏联政府聘请芝加哥工程公司亨利·弗赖恩公司设计马格尼托哥尔斯克综合钢铁厂，这是苏联计划中最大的单一项目。
该设计以巨大规模复制了弗赖恩的工程师为印第安纳州加里的美国钢铁公司设计的工厂。这是德国军事模式的突击动员，创造了“一个技术完善的未来的集结地”。
计划意味着工厂混乱地倍增、反复的临时应付、一个数量不断增殖且年度目标不可能完成的未来。苏联中央计划以其雄心和速度启发了世界各国政府，但它把未来计算为实体工厂和物质产出的迅速倍增，使当下变得更加而非更少混乱。
en: The example of Soviet central planning might have offered an alternative way to control the future, but it appeared no better. As a centrepiece of the 1929 ‘Five Year Plan for the Development of the National Economy’, the Soviet government hired the Chicago engineering firm of Henry Freyn and Company to design an integrated iron and steel complex at Magnitogorsk, the largest single venture in Soviet planning.

The design reproduced on a gargantuan scale the plant that Freyn’s engineers had designed for the US Steel Company at Gary, Indiana. This was crash mobilisation, on the German military model, creating ‘a rallying point for a technologically perfected future’.

Planning meant the chaotic multiplication of factories, repeated improvisation, a future of proliferating numerical quantities and impossible annual targets. Soviet central planning inspired governments around the world with its ambition and speed, but its deployment of the future calculated as the rapid multiplication of physical plant and material output rendered the present more rather than less chaotic.

zh: 值得一提的是，凯恩斯——关注苏联实验的人之一——并不是经济增长的理论家。他把摆脱经济萧条下行螺旋所需的扩张时期，想象为有限的暂时加速时期，通向未来的稳定状态。对凯恩斯来说，增长不是成功的指标，而是一种潜在的不稳定力量。
en: Keynes, it is worth remembering – one of those who followed the Soviet experiment – was not a theorist of economic growth. He imagined the period of expansion required to escape from the downward spiral of economic depression as a limited period of temporary acceleration, leading to a future steady state. For Keynes, growth was not a metric of success but a potentially destabilising force.

zh: 在 1940 年代后期之前，经济学家把增长作为周期性实体扩张问题来讨论。在新政、战争和战后生产重组的背景下，他们把增长视为让闲置工厂重新投入运营、为失业者创造就业的问题。这种“扩张”被设想为生产活动增长和收缩的周期性过程——商业周期——的一部分。扩张本身不是目的。相反，目标是熨平高峰和低谷，必要时限制扩张以减轻衰退的严重程度，并努力减少可能妨碍从停滞中复苏的商品或劳动力供应瓶颈。
en: Before the late 1940s, economists discussed growth as a question of periodic physical expansion. In the context of the New Deal, the war, and postwar restructuring of production, they saw growth as a question of putting idle plants back into service and creating jobs for those out of work. Such ‘expansion’ was envisioned as part of a cyclical process of the growth and contraction of productive activity – the business cycle. Expansion was not an end in itself. Instead, the goal was to smooth out peaks and troughs, restricting expansions where necessary to decrease the severity of downturns, and attempting to reduce bottlenecks in the supply of goods or labour that might hamper recovery from stagnation.

zh: 到 1930 年代，早先对物质生活长期扩张的期望，已经让位于关于达到实体增长极限所导致的停滞的论点。在 1932 年的一次总统竞选演讲中，富兰克林·D. 罗斯福警告说：
en: By the 1930s, earlier prospects of a long-term expansion of material life had given way to arguments about a stagnation brought on by reaching the limits of physical growth. In a presidential campaign speech in 1932, Franklin D. Roosevelt warned:

zh: 我们的工业设施已经建成；眼下的问题是，在现有条件下，它是否已经过度建设。我们最后的边疆早已到达，实际上不再有可自由取得的土地……我们无法邀请欧洲移民来分享我们无尽的富足。我们如今正在为本国人民提供单调乏味的生活……显然，这一切都要求重新评估价值。一个只会建造更多工业设施、创建更多铁路系统、组织更多公司的人，既可能带来帮助，也同样可能带来危险……我们现在的任务不是发现或开发自然资源，也不一定是生产更多商品。我们现在的任务是更冷静、更不戏剧化的事务：管理已有的资源和工厂……使现有经济组织服务于人民。
en: Our industrial plant is built; the problem just now is whether under existing conditions it is not overbuilt. Our last frontier has long since been reached, and there is practically no more free land . . . We are not able to invite the immigration from Europe to share our endless plenty. We are now providing a drab living for our own people . . . Clearly, all this calls for a re-appraisal of values. A mere builder of more industrial plants, a creator of more railroad systems, an organizer of more corporations, is as likely to be a danger as a help . . . Our task now is not discovery or exploitation of natural resources, or necessarily producing more goods. It is the soberer, less dramatic business of administering resources and plants already in hand . . . of adapting existing economic organizations to the service of the people.

zh: 1938 年，阿尔文·汉森在美国经济学会主席演讲中表达了同样的观点，即“长期停滞”学说。十年后，战后经济及其增长的效果，用围绕一个新对象——这个对象似乎具有无限增长的能力——的政治，取代了这种商业生活长期扩张和停滞的过程。
en: In 1938, the same views were expressed by Alvin Hansen in his address as President of the American Economic Association, as the doctrine of ‘secular stagnation’. A decade later, the postwar effect of the economy and its growth replaced this process of secular expansion and stagnation of commercial life with a politics oriented around a new object that was somehow capable, it seemed, of perpetual growth.

zh: 技术知识中不可估量的资源
en: Imponderable Resources in Technical Knowledge

zh: 鉴于此前所有这些经验，如何才可能把一种指数增长模式转化为稳定效果？一个微小但重要的解决办法是一种新的再现方法：对数图。在绘制这个新对象即经济的增长图表时，人们可以不按线性纵轴、而按调整过以显示变化率的纵轴来标绘 GDP 随时间的增长；换言之，使用对数尺度，纵轴上的间隔代表比率。这一技巧把指数曲线变成一条直线。以每年 3.75% 增长的经济，于是可以表现为一条平稳的线，平缓而均匀地向上延伸，横贯页面。稳定的不是增长过程，而是其增长率。政治要求或经济决策的微小变化所产生的效果，如今可以清晰地投射在纸上——未来不再显得是一种无法阻挡的加速。
en: How, given all this previous experience, was it possible to turn a pattern of exponential growth into a stabilising effect? One small but significant solution to the problem was a new method of representation, the log plot. In drawing charts of the growth of this new object, the economy, one could plot the growth of GDP over time not against a linear vertical scale but with the scale adjusted to show the rate of change; in other words, by using a logarithmic scale, in which the intervals on the vertical axis represent ratios. This trick turns an exponential curve into a straight line. An economy growing at 3.75 per cent per year can then be represented as a steady line, rising gently and uniformly across the page. What is steady is not the process of increase, but its rate. The effect of small changes in political demands or economic decisions could now be clearly projected on paper – and the future no longer appeared as an unstoppable acceleration.

zh: 通过这类物质性铭写，经济作为一个非物质对象出现了，一组计算把现代性的加速增长转化为一个看似稳定的未来。以这种方式以及许多其他方式，经济——也许仅仅持续了二三十年——使未来成为一种治理工具。
en: Through such material inscriptions, the economy emerged as a nonmaterial object, a set of calculations that converted the accelerating growth of modernity into an apparently stable future. In ways like this and many others, the economy, perhaps just for two or three decades, made the future an instrument of government.

zh: 对数图虽然有用，但远不是使未来显得可治理的唯一装置。GDP 的计算——以及它排除了什么——本身也很重要。但伊拉克和其他中东国家那些工人同样重要。他们以两种方式提供了帮助。
en: The log plot, although useful, was far from the only device to make the future appear governable. The calculation of GDP – and what that excluded – was itself important. But so too were those workers in Iraq and other countries of the Middle East. They helped in two ways.

zh: 第一，把能源生产外包到中东，帮助打破了战后北美、尤其是欧洲的劳工抗议浪潮；在这些抗议中，有组织的工人要求对集体财富的索取权进行更彻底的重新配置。煤矿工人与码头工人和铁路工人结盟，在把大众民主和更平等的生活形式带给西方方面发挥了关键作用。他们对抗资本化力量，在两次世界大战之间和战争年代促成了
一次前所未有的财富再分配。
然而从现在起，工人收入的增加将不是来自利润再分配，而是来自那条稳定上升的线。输油管线和图表线条将协同运作。当然，如果增长率走平或回落，大多数人的收入将“自然地”停滞或下降。
en: First, the outsourcing of energy production to the Middle East helped break the postwar wave of labour protests, in North America and even more so in Europe, in which organised workers were demanding a more far-reaching reconfiguration of claims to collective wealth. Coal miners had played a critical role, in alliance with dockers and railway workers, in bringing popular democracy and more egalitarian forms of life to the West. Working against the forces of capitalisation, they had engineered
an unprecedented redistribution of wealth in the interwar and wartime decades.

From now on, however, increases in the income of workers were to come not from a redistribution of profits but from the steadily rising line. Pipelines and graph lines would work together. If the rate of growth levelled off or dropped back, of course, the income of most people would ‘naturally’ stagnate or decline.

zh: 第二，由于石油，生产率得以增长，从而收入得以增加；1945 年后的四分之一世纪里，石油供应增加，价格逐渐下降。石油公司竭力限制供应，并力图把供应欧洲的中东石油价格固定在美国石油高得多的水平上——这一价格由美国各州层面的生产配额设定，旨在维持石油稀缺，从而维持非同寻常的企业利润水平。但这些限制从来不够充分，产油国政府不断施压要求增加产量或提高收入份额，石油公司越来越难以应对这种压力。结果，石油价格逐渐下降。到 1970 年，石油实际价格自 1920 年以来每个十年都在下降。因此，几十年来，能源供应似乎无限，其成本对许多用途来说微不足道。如果说经济显得能够无限增长，那是由于二十世纪中叶能源体制的实际原因。
en: Second, productivity could grow, and thus incomes increase, thanks to oil, which for a quarter century after 1945 increased in supply and gradually declined in price. Oil companies tried hard to restrict supply and fix the price of Middle Eastern oil supplied to Europe at the much higher level of oil produced in the United States – a price set by state-level production quotas designed to maintain the scarcity of oil and thus extraordinary levels of corporate profit. But these restrictions were never adequate, and there was a constant pressure from the governments in oil-producing countries for increased output or an increased share of revenues, a pressure the oil companies found it increasingly difficult to manage. As a result, the price of oil gradually declined. By 1970, oil’s price in real terms had been declining in every decade since 1920. Thus, for several decades, the supply of energy seemed unlimited and its costs, for many purposes, negligible. If the economy appeared capable of unlimited growth, this was for practical reasons of the mid-twentieth-century energy regime.

zh: 人们还可以探讨，经济中新的增长计算如何解决了和平时期军费开支的问题。在经济被制造出来之前，很难想象 1947—8 年之后建立永久军事化社会的决定，如何不以牺牲大多数人的福利和工资改善为代价。中东那些脆弱点——美国“国家安全”很快被认为在那里尤其面临风险——构成了这种新政治经济效果的一部分。
en: One could also explore how the new calculation of growth in an economy solved the problem of peacetime military spending. Before the making of the economy, it was difficult to imagine how the decision to build a permanently militarised society after 1947–8 was not somehow at the expense of improvements in welfare and wages for the majority. Those points of vulnerability in the Middle East, where US ‘national security’ was soon deemed to be especially at risk, formed part of this new political-economic effect.

zh: 通过未来来治理人民，也成为管理前殖民地世界人口的一种装置。1940 年，经济统计学家科林·克拉克——他曾发展英国用于计算国民收入的方法——公布了各地国民收入的第一批估算。他对富国与穷国之间不平等程度的计算引起了震动。
但经济效果的这种普遍化和重复也引发了问题。例如，西蒙·库兹涅茨没有预料到他的 GDP 估算方法会被用来进行简单的跨国比较。这些统计暗示每个国家都有一个
对等的经济，一种相似的货币化关系安排，可以进行比较和排序。然而，即使据说每个国家都有一个经济，在如今将被称为欠发达地区的地方产生这种效果，也需要不同的方法，并提供不同的政治可能性。其中最重要的可能性之一是，工业化国家可以试图不仅治理本国人口，还通过其余世界的未来来治理与它们的关系。
en: Governing people through their future also became a device for managing populations in the formerly colonised world. In 1940 the economic statistician Colin Clark, who had developed the methods used in Britain for the calculation of national income, published the first estimates of national incomes everywhere. His calculations of the degree of inequality between rich and poor countries caused a shock.

But this generalisation and repetition of the effect of the economy also raised questions. Simon Kuznets, for example, had not expected his methods of estimating GDP to be used to produce simple inter-country comparisons. The statistics implied that every country had an

equivalent economy, a similar arrangement of monetarised relations, which could be compared and ranked. However, even if every country was said to have an economy, producing this effect in what were now to be called underdeveloped areas required different methods and offered different political possibilities. One of the most significant of these possibilities was that industrialised states could attempt to govern not only their own populations but also relations with the rest of the world through their futures.

zh: 在国际关系中，未来出人意料地进入了治理。哈里·杜鲁门在 1949 年 1 月的总统就职演说中宣布了“发展”时代的到来。

这一宣布是一个事后补充。当被要求提出一幅指导总统第二任期的未来愿景时，国务院官员提出了三点：支持联合国、马歇尔计划和北大西洋公约组织。但这些是总统在 1948 年秋整个竞选期间一直在讨论的现有政策。杜鲁门的一位助手告诉国务院，他需要第四点，某种“稍微有点原创性的东西”。国务院的人发现很难想象未来。“那些日子里，人们听到许多关于需要长远思考和长远规划的话，国务院的人也试图为此组织起来，”其中一人后来解释说。但“他们的规划努力通常陷入时事问题，例如如何处理大西洋下的意大利电缆，或购买锡应支付什么价格”。
en: In international relations, the future entered government unexpectedly. Harry Truman announced the arrival of the era of ‘development’ in his January 1949 inaugural presidential address.

The announcement was an afterthought. Asked to formulate a vision of the future to guide the president’s second term, officials in the State Department came up with three points: support for the United Nations (UN), the Marshall Plan, and the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO). But these were existing policies that the president had been discussing throughout the election campaign in the fall of 1948. An assistant for Truman told the State Department that he needed a fourth point, something ‘that’s just a bit original’. The men at State found it difficult to imagine the future. ‘One heard a great deal of the need for long-range thinking and long-range planning in those days, and the State Department men tried to organise themselves for it’, one of them later explained. But ‘their efforts at planning generally bogged down in topical questions, such as what to do with the Italian cable under the Atlantic, or what price to pay for tin’.
body.review: 校注：本段用北约名称概述1948年竞选期间的政策。北约官方历史记载，正式公开条约谈判于1948年12月开始，北大西洋公约于1949年4月4日签署。这里应区分此前的联盟构想与已经成立的组织。正文保留原作追述。 https://nato.int/en/about-us/organization/founding-treaty

zh: 一位一直协助拉丁美洲技术援助项目的官员建议，这类援助也可以提供给世界其他地区。这个想法被匆忙插入演讲。杜鲁门宣布了后来被称为“第四点”的内容（当时没有时间给这个想法命名）：“一项大胆的新计划，使我们科学进步和工业发展的益处可用于欠发达地区的改善和增长”。
战后美国的发展政治并非作为帝国愿景、而是作为事后的补充而出现。
en: An official who had been helping with technical assistance programmes in Latin America suggested that such aid could also be offered to other parts of the world. The idea was hastily inserted in the speech. Truman announced what became known as Point Four (there had been no time to name the idea): ‘A bold new program for making the benefits of our scientific advances and industrial progress available for the improvement and growth of underdeveloped areas’.
The postwar US politics of development emerged not as an imperial vision but as an afterthought.

zh: 与国内国民经济这一装置一样，新的发展政治代表了一种把未来带入治理的新方式。
这种愿景不是关于美国如何与世界分享其财富，或支持中东石油工人争取获得石油公司利润更大份额、创造更公平生活形式的权利。1948 年 3 月，在古巴哈瓦那举行的联合国

贸易与就业会议通过了《国际贸易组织宪章》。该组织与国际货币基金组织和世界银行并列，构成第三个机构，旨在治理国际贸易，包括石油和其他商品贸易。根据该协定，石油公司卡特尔和其他私人贸易安排将被公共监管的协定取代。国际投资和贸易将受劳工权利原则和充分就业权治理。印度和其他全球南方国家希望利用这一新组织，把更大份额的商品生产和贸易利润转给生产国。同时还有要求为这些国家制定马歇尔计划的呼声，以物质援助形式返还部分利润。美国反对这些提案。在美国国会拒绝批准《国际贸易组织宪章》后，建立该组织的协议破裂了。
en: As with the device of the national economy at home, the new politics of development represented a novel way of bringing the future into government.

The vision was not one of how America would share its wealth with the world or support the rights of oil workers in the Middle East trying to access a better share of oil company profits and create more equitable forms of life. In March 1948, the UN Conference on

Trade and Employment in Havana, Cuba, had adopted the charter of an International Trade Organization. Forming a third body alongside the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank, the organisation was intended to govern international trade, including trade in oil and other commodities. Under the agreement, oil company cartels and other private trade arrangements would be replaced with publicly regulated agreements. International investment and trade would be governed by principles of labour rights and the right to full employment. India and other countries from the South hoped to use the new organisation to redirect a greater share of the profits from production and trade in goods to the producer countries. There were concurrent demands for a Marshall Plan for such countries, to return some of those profits in the form of material assistance. The United States opposed such proposals. The agreement to create the International Trade Organization collapsed after the US Congress refused to ratify its charter.
body.review: 校注：底本概括为美国国会拒绝批准宪章。世界贸易组织的历史说明具体记为：国会反对强烈，美国政府于1950年宣布不再寻求国会批准《哈瓦那宪章》。原作概述不宜据此理解为一次明确的否决表决。 https://www.wto.org/English/thewto_e/whatis_e/tif_e/fact4_e.htm

zh: 作为对国际贸易监管和把劳工权利扩展至伊拉克石油工人等群体的替代方案，杜鲁门的演讲动员了未来，如今被理解为各国经济的发展或增长。美国将作出的贡献不是物质援助，也不是对劳工权利的支持，而是某种无限的东西：技术知识。“我们能够用于援助其他民族的物质资源是有限的，”杜鲁门解释说。此外，“其资源和劳动力投入这些发展的人民的利益”，必须通过“对投资者的保障”来“平衡”。与这些必要的限制相反，“我们在技术知识方面不可估量的资源不断增长，取之不尽”。
没有多余资本，不会有针对伊朗、埃及或印度等国的马歇尔计划，也不会支持组织工会或集体行动以改善就业和交换条件的权利。美国将用技术知识和建议的托词，取代物质资源和曾在西方创造广泛富裕的劳工权利。这些技术知识将在各个领域提供，但越来越多地采取一种主要形式：经济计算。这是一种与有限物质资源相反的、取之不尽的专门知识。
en: As a substitute for the international regulation of trade and the extension of labour rights to people like the oil workers of Iraq, Truman’s speech mobilised the future, now understood as the development or growth of national economies. The contribution the United States would make was not material assistance, or support for labour rights, but something unlimited: technical know-how. ‘The material resources which we can afford to use for assistance of other peoples are limited’, Truman explained. The ‘interest of the people whose resources and whose labor go into these developments’, moreover, had to be ‘balanced’ by ‘guarantees to the investor’. In contrast to these necessary limitations, ‘our imponderable resources in technical knowledge are constantly growing and are inexhaustible’.

There was no capital to spare, and there would be no Marshall Plan for countries such as Iran, Egypt, or India, and no support for the right to unionise or act collectively to improve terms of employment and exchange. In place of material resources and the labour rights that had created widespread affluence in the West, the United States would offer the alibi of know-how and technical advice. The know-how would be offered in various fields, but, increasingly, in one main form: economic calculation. A know-how that, in contrast to limited material resources, was inexhaustible.

zh: 讲求物质的埃及人
en: The Materially Minded Egyptian

zh: 让我们回到 1948 年 5 月的阿拉伯世界，当时伊拉克石油工人的抗议在费卢杰以失败告终。碰巧的是，这座城镇把自己的名字给了那年夏天另一次挫折，即巴勒斯坦法卢贾发生的事件。法卢贾是加沙地区的一个村庄，大约位于沿海加沙城和山城哈利勒（希伯伦）之间；它得名于村民为一位来自伊拉克的十四世纪苏菲导师沙哈卜丁·法卢吉修建的圣陵，因而间接得名于那座伊拉克城镇。
1948 年 5 月的同一周对巴勒斯坦来说是命运攸关的一周。
en: Let us return to the Arab world in May 1948, where the protests of Iraqi oil workers had ended in defeat at Falluja. As it happens, the town gave its name to a second setback that summer, an event in Faluja, Palestine. A village in the District of Gaza, lying about halfway between the town of Gaza on the coast and the hill town of al-Khalil, or Hebron, Faluja was named after a shrine the villagers had built to a fourteenth-century Sufi master from Iraq, Shahab al-Din al-Faluji, and thus indirectly after the Iraqi town.
The same week of May 1948 was a fateful one for Palestine.

zh: 英国曾宣布 5 月 14 日星期五将是其占领巴勒斯坦的最后一天。联合国曾提出一项方案，把该国在犹太复国主义定居者——他们集中在最大的城镇中的六个以及一些农业定居点——与土著人口——他们居住在该国各个地区，人数约为犹太移民的两倍——之间进行分治。但没有人同意实施分治，或组织把巴勒斯坦人从他们的城镇和村庄迁走，而族群分离的计划似乎要求这样做。当美国铁路工人被杜鲁门政府强迫复工、伊拉克大规模石油罢工遭到失败时，巴勒斯坦人面临一场更大的灾难。
en: Britain had announced that Friday, 14 May, would be the final day of its occupation of Palestine. The UN had proposed a scheme to partition the country between the Zionist settlers, who were concentrated in half a dozen of the largest towns and a number of agricultural settlements, and the indigenous population, who inhabited every region of the country and outnumbered the immigrant Jewish population by about two to one. But no one had agreed to implement the partition or organise the removal of the Palestinian people from their towns and villages, as the plan for ethnic separation apparently required. While railway workers in the United States were forced back to work by the Truman government, and the mass oil strike in Iraq met defeat, Palestinians faced a larger calamity.

zh: 到英国人撤离时，组织良好的犹太复国主义部队的军事行动和恐怖行动已经使多达 40 万巴勒斯坦人逃离家园。

次日，5 月 15 日，埃及士兵从南方进入巴勒斯坦，而来自外约旦的一支与埃及方面竞争的军队（在与犹太复国主义领导层秘密谈判后）控制了约旦河西岸。埃及人最初控制了该国南部，但当犹太复国主义部队后来突破防线进入南部时，埃及军队的一个旅被困在法卢贾的一小块领土上——这个村庄连接着后来的西岸和加沙地区残余部分（后来称为加沙地带）。在四个月后的停战谈判中，埃及被迫放弃后来被称为“法卢贾口袋”的地区，尽管 1947 年的分治提案和 1948 年夏天联合国修订计划都曾要求保留该地区，作为残余巴勒斯坦国的一部分。作为埃及撤出被围部队的交换，新的犹太复国主义国家政府——其领导人经过一番辩论后决定把它称为“以色列”国而不是锡安——
同意让该地区的巴勒斯坦人口留在原地。协议达成后几周内，法卢贾村民就在枪击、殴打、强奸未遂和其他恐怖行动中被赶走，这些行动由南巴勒斯坦犹太复国主义种族清洗行动指挥官伊扎克·拉宾“策划”。
沿海地带与山地之间的人口联系和领土连续性被切断，为包围加沙地带和在南巴勒斯坦建立犹太复国主义定居点扫清了道路。
en: By the time the British departed, military actions and terror campaigns carried out by the well-organised Zionist forces had already driven as many as 400,000 Palestinians from their homes.

On the following day, 15 May, Egyptian soldiers entered Palestine from the south, while a rival army from Transjordan (following secret talks with the Zionist leadership) took control of the west bank of the Jordan River. The Egyptians initially held the southern parts of the country, but, when the Zionist forces later broke through their lines into the south, an Egyptian brigade was trapped in a pocket of territory at Faluja, the village linking what would become the West Bank and a remnant of Gaza District, later termed the Gaza Strip. In the armistice negotiations four months later, Egypt was forced to abandon the Faluja Pocket, as the area became known, although the partition proposal of 1947 and a revised UN plan in the summer of 1948 had called for retaining that area as part of the rump Palestinian state. In exchange for Egypt withdrawing its besieged force, the government of the new Zionist state, whose leaders – after some debate – had decided to call it the state of ‘Israel’ rather than Zion,

agreed to leave the area’s Palestinian population in place. Within weeks of the agreement, the villagers of Faluja were forced out, through a campaign of shootings, beatings, attempted rape, and other acts of terror, ‘orchestrated’ by the commander of the Zionist ethnic cleansing operations in southern Palestine, Yitzhak Rabin.

The population link and territorial contiguity between the coastal strip and the hills was severed, and the way cleared for the encirclement of the Gaza Strip and the Zionist settlement of southern Palestine.

zh: 1948 年发生在伊拉克费卢杰和巴勒斯坦法卢贾这两个同名之地的失败，标志着同一相连过程的两面。埃及的失败巩固了犹太复国主义对南巴勒斯坦的控制，并把设法留在该国的大多数巴勒斯坦人限制在西岸和加沙地带两个飞地内。英国支持犹太复国主义定居点，部分是因为一个欧洲定居者少数群体的形成造成了一个脆弱点，需要帝国存在来保护它。第二次世界大战后，英国再也无力维持这种旧式保护国，其基础是需要对欧洲定居者提供武装保护。而定居者本身在战时军事化以及美苏竞相支持他们的竞争中得到加强，帮助迫使英国撤出。1948 年后，帝国保护采取新形式，建立在新的脆弱性之上。扩大石油生产使伊拉克、伊朗以及后来阿拉伯地区的劳工组织得以兴起，但也让美国作为保护者进入该地区，保护伊朗和沙特阿拉伯等国政权，这些政权将监控并阻止劳工组织。试图清除巴勒斯坦社会将造成另一个脆弱性，华盛顿后来作为以色列国保护者加以利用。
en: The two Faluja defeats of 1948, in Iraq and Palestine, mark two sides of a connected process. The Egyptian defeat consolidated the Zionist control of southern Palestine and the confinement of most of the Palestinians who managed to remain in the country within two enclaves, the West Bank and the Gaza Strip. Britain had supported Zionist settlement in part because the creation of a European settler minority established a point of vulnerability that required an imperial presence for its protection. After the Second World War, Britain could no longer afford to run this old kind of protectorate, based on the need for armed protection of European settlers. And the settlers themselves, strengthened by their own wartime militarisation and by a competition between the United States and the USSR to support them, had helped force the British out. After 1948, imperial protection took new forms, based on new vulnerabilities. Expanding oil production enabled the rise of labour organising in Iraq, Iran, and later in Arabia, but it also allowed the United States into the region as the protector of regimes in countries such as Iran and Saudi Arabia that would police and prevent labour’s organisation. The attempted removal of Palestinian society would create another vulnerability that Washington was later to take advantage of, as protector of the state of Israel.

zh: 在埃及，一场规模超过海湾国家、且有着悠久政治行动历史的劳工运动，在 1947—8 年组织了一波罢工和工业抗议。罢工从大型纺织厂和其他工业企业开始，然后蔓延到经营苏伊士运河的英法公司、苏伊士的壳牌炼油厂、石油分销商和许多其他企业。1948 年 4 月和 5 月巴勒斯坦的紧急状态使政府得以实施戒严、打破罢工，并监禁数千名政权的主要反对者。
en: In Egypt, a labour movement that was larger than those of the Gulf states and which had enjoyed a long history of political action had organised a wave of strikes and industrial protests in 1947–8. The strikes began in the large textile mills and other industrial enterprises, then spread to the Anglo-French company operating the Suez Canal, the Shell oil refinery at Suez, petroleum distributors, and many others. The emergency in Palestine in April and May 1948 allowed the government to impose martial law, break the strikes, and imprison thousands of leading opponents of the regime.

zh: 埃及军队在巴勒斯坦的失败激励了一群初级军官，他们组成了一个秘密组织“自由军官”，以打击该国军事和政治

领导层的腐败，并支持结束英国在埃及持续帝国存在的民众运动。该组织领导人贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔就是被困法卢贾口袋四个月的人之一。1952 年 7 月推翻英国支持的君主制后，自由军官推出了一项温和计划，把王室地产和其他大宗地产分配给无地者。这些政策遭到旧秩序的抵制，旧秩序的基础在大地主之中，而左翼团体则要求更激进的变革。1954 年 3 月，与反对者的摊牌以亲纳赛尔工会组织的大罢工告终——运输工人、银行雇员和苏伊士工人参与其中。这场力量展示使纳赛尔得以击败左右两方面的反对。为了扩大民众支持，政权宣布革命新时代，并采取一项宏伟计划来改造埃及的物质和集体生活。然而，这场革命不是要通过尼罗河谷的进一步土地再分配来运作，而是要通过一项扩展河谷的计划，即在阿斯旺修建高坝。
en: The defeat of the Egyptian army in Palestine galvanised a group of junior army officers, who formed a secret organisation, the Free Officers, to combat the corruption of the country’s military and political

leadership and support a popular movement to end Britain’s continuing imperial presence in Egypt. The leader of the group, Gamal Abd al-Nasser, was one of those who had been trapped for four months in the Faluja Pocket. After overthrowing the British-supported monarchy in July 1952, the Free Officers introduced a modest programme to redistribute the royal estates and other very large landholdings to the landless. These policies met resistance from the old order, with its base among large landowners, while leftist groups demanded more radical change. In March 1954, a showdown with opponents culminated in a general strike organised by pro-Nasser unions – transport workers, bank employees, and the workers at Suez. The show of strength enabled Nasser to defeat opposition from right and left. To extend its popular support, the regime declared a new era of revolution and adopted a grand plan to remake Egyptian material and collective life. The revolution, however, was to operate not through a further redistribution of land in the Nile Valley but through a scheme to expand the valley, by building the High Dam at Aswan.

zh: 世界银行提出帮助资助阿斯旺项目的故事广为人知。
由于资助欧洲战后重建的使命已由马歇尔计划接替，世界银行抓住机会表明自己已从金融机构转变为如今可称为“发展”机构的组织，提出为世界上最大的堆石坝提供融资。这家银行甚至考虑把大坝作为解决巴勒斯坦问题的工具：把灌溉水从苏伊士运河下引到西奈北部，并在那里安置巴勒斯坦难民，或许可以让联合国近东巴勒斯坦难民救济和工程处——为救济难民而设立的机构——分担大坝成本。
但犹太复国主义者对西奈另有计划。1955 年 2 月，以色列对加沙的埃及军队发动袭击，由此迈出了向南巴勒斯坦其余地区和西奈推进、占领直至苏伊士的埃及领土的第一步。
en: The story of the World Bank’s offer to help fund the Aswan project is well known.

Having lost its mission of funding postwar reconstruction in Europe to the Marshall Plan, the Bank seized the opportunity to demonstrate its transformation from a financial institution into what could now be called a ‘development’ agency, by offering to finance the largest rock-fill dam in the world. The Bank even contemplated using the dam as an instrument for solving the Palestine question: bringing irrigation water under the Suez Canal to northern Sinai and settling Palestine refugees there might have allowed the UN Relief and Works Agency, the agency set up to provide relief for the refugees, to contribute to the cost of the dam.

But the Zionists had other plans for Sinai. In February 1955 Israel launched an attack on the Egyptian forces in Gaza, taking the first step to capture the remainder of southern Palestine and seize Sinai, occupying Egyptian territory as far as Suez.
